correctness.rationale: For every automorphism matrix, the fixed subgroup is ker(phi-I), whose size equals the cokernel size because the underlying group is finite. The cokernel relation matrix has four explicit columns; the gcd of its six 2-by-2 minors gives the exact p-adic exponent of the fixed subgroup. For gap at least three the determinant minor reduces modulo p^3 to uz, while gap two requires an explicit cancellation count against p^2 beta gamma. All five formula branches follow from exhaustive valuation strata. The packaged replay independently enumerates automorphisms across every branch and directly checks fixed points in the smallest examples.

originality.rationale: The 2018 source gives the general fixed-point-free count and poses the broader distinct-exponent theta-value problem, but it does not count p^2-fixers beyond its smallest rank-two example. Published low-exponent papers cover the isolated pairs (1,2), (1,3), and (2,3). The final theorem excludes the covered (1,3) separated pair and gives uniform formulas for all remaining separated rank-two pairs. The 2022 Reidemeister-spectrum theorem determines occurrence of fixed-point cardinalities rather than multiplicities of automorphisms. Targeted searches found no formula implying the five separated-exponent cases.

value.rationale: The 2018 literature explicitly asks for theta values on direct sums with distinct cyclic exponents. The theorem resolves a complete natural layer of that program for rank two: every separated exponent pair outside one already solved boundary case. The five cases expose a structural transition at exponent gap two, where determinant-minor cancellation changes the enumeration. This is a uniform infinite-family result rather than an isolated table computation.
